      <article id="post-4" class="post-4 page type-page status-publish hentry no-post-thumbnail">
        

<div class="entry-content content">


  <div id="cs-content" class="cs-content"><div class="x-section e4-e1 m4-0"><div class="x-row e4-e2 m4-1 m4-2"><div class="x-row-inner"><div class="x-col e4-e3 m4-3"><span class="x-image e4-e4 m4-4"><img decoding="async" src="https://kiteschoolportugal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Website-1-9_1920x934-1.jpeg" width="960" height="467" alt="Image" loading="lazy"></span></div></div></div></div><div id="x-section-1" class="x-section" style="margin: 0px 0px 20px;padding: 0px; background-color: transparent;" ><div id="" class="x-container max width" style="margin: 0px auto;padding: 0px;" ><div  class="x-column x-sm x-1-1" style="padding: 0px;" ><h1  class="h-custom-headline h3" ><span>Kite holidays - yoga, surf, SUP | Algarve, Portugal</span></h1></div></div><div id="" class="x-container max width marginless-columns" style="margin: 0px auto;padding: 0;" ><div id="" class="x-container max width" style="margin: 0px auto;padding: 0px;" ></div><div  class="x-column x-sm x-1-1" style="padding: 0px;" ><div id="" class="x-text" style="" ><p><div  class="x-columnize" ><strong>+ VDWS certified kite lessons &amp; SUP tours<br />
+ Accomodation, school and equipment rental for kite, SUP and surf<br />
+ Learn to kitesurf on the flatwater lagoon of Alvor in Lagos, Algarve<br />
+ Excellent kite surfing conditions for beginners<br />
+ Comfy and stylish kitecamp and surf house in Burgau<br />
+ Buzzing nightlife and culture in nearby Lagos<br />
+ Kitesurfing, Stand Up Paddleboarding, surfing, windsurfing, yoga, and loads of other amazing activities</strong></p>
<p><strong>If you love the ocean, this corner of Portugal is a huge adventure playground. If you also love good company in a relaxed yet sociable guest house, we're happy to offer you all of it in one package at the <a href="https://kiteschoolportugal.com/the-ocean-spirits-kitesurf-camp/">Ocean Spirit Lodge.</a> </strong></p>
<p>Being spoilt for choice has never been so entertaining: The coastline between Lagos and Sagres provides spectacular conditions for kitesurfing, Stand Up Paddleboarding and surfing. If you want to, you can even do it all in one day – and that's exactly the reason why most people want to stay longer than just one day. Much longer, that is...<br />
</div></p>
</div><div  class="x-column x-sm x-1-2" style="padding: 20px 0 0;margin-bottom: 0;" ></div><a  class="x-btn x-btn-global" style="float: left; margin-right: 20px;" href="https://kiteschoolportugal.com/booking-form/"     data-options="thumbnail: ''">Booking Request</a><div id="" class="x-text" style="float: left;" ><h3 style="margin-top: 0;">+351 932 839 003 <small style="font-size: 22px;">(Whatsapp)</small></h3>

20px 0 0 0;"><h2  class="h-custom-headline man h3 accent" ><span>Kite/Surf/ SUP Camp </span></h2><hr  class="x-gap" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;"><div id="" class="x-text cs-ta-center" style="" ><p>If you love boardsports in the ocean, this corner of Portugal is a huge adventure playground. If you also love good company in a relaxed yet sociable guest house, we're happy to offer you all of it in one package at the Ocean Spirits Lodge.</p>
</div><hr  class="x-gap" style="margin: 20px 0 0 0;"><a  class="x-btn x-btn-global" style="margin-top: 10px;" href="https://kiteschoolportugal.com/packages/"     data-options="thumbnail: ''">Our 0;"><div id="" class="x-text" style="" ><p class="man">Kite lessons for all levels and ages from 14 to 75. Professionalism, security and fun are guaranteed. All our instructors are experienced and have international VDWS and IKO  certificates. We use brand new equipment from the market leader North Kiteboarding.</p>
</div><hr  class="x-gap" style="margin: 20px 0 0 0;"><a  class="x-btn x-btn-global" style="margin-top: 10px;" href="https://kiteschoolportugal.com/kitesurfing-lessons/"     data-options="thumbnail: 10px 0 0 0;"><div id="" class="x-text" style="" ><p class="man">Explore the breathtaking, unspoiled coastline of the Algarve on a Stand Up Paddleboard. Our tours are suitable for all ages, no matter if you’re doing it for the first time or if you’re an experience SUP surferer.  We use brand new equipment from the market leader Fanatic.</p>
</div><hr  class="x-gap" style="margin: 20px 0 0 0;"><a  class="x-btn x-btn-global" style="margin-top: 10px;" href="https://kiteschoolportugal.com/sup-algarve-lagos/"     data-options="thumbnail: ''">Read more<i  class="x-icon mvn mls mrn x-icon-angle-right" data-x-icon-s="&#xf105;" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></div></div></div><div id="x-section-3" class="x-section" style="margin: 0px;padding: 45px 0px; background-color: hsl(44, 62%, 85%);" ><div id="" class="x-container max width" style="margin: 0px auto;padding: 0px;" ><div  class="x-column x-sm x-1-1" style="padding: 0px;" ><div id="" class="x-text" style="" ><h2 style="margin-top: 10px;">Die Ocean Spirits Kite/SUP/Surf Lodge</h2>
<p><strong><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" class="wp-image-1136 size-medium alignright" src="https://kiteschoolportugal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/OS-ProfilePic-FB-water-RGB-300x300.jpg" width="300" height="300" srcset="https://kiteschoolportugal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/OS-ProfilePic-FB-water-RGB-300x300.jpg 300w, https://kiteschoolportugal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/OS-ProfilePic-FB-water-RGB-150x150.jpg 150w, https://kiteschoolportugal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/OS-ProfilePic-FB-water-RGB-100x100.jpg 100w, https://kiteschoolportugal.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/OS-ProfilePic-FB-water-RGB.jpg 708w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 300px) 100vw, 300px" />Close enough to the buzzing tourist hotspot Lagos, but far enough to enjoy the relaxed vibe of nature. Excellent kite, surf and SUP spots in all directions. These are the main reasons why we love Burgau. And there's the food. Screamingly fresh fish straight off the boat, Portuguese or international delicacies - you name it. Oh, did we already mention the laid-back little beach and the super scenic walks along the cliffs...?</strong></p>
<p>The Southwest Algarve is a very special place for all kinds of watersports and tours. Located on the tip of land between the South-facing coast and West-facing coast around Sagres and Lagos, there's always different wind and swell directions just around the corner. No matter what activity we want to do, kite lessons, surfing or SUP in Lagos - the perfect conditions are usually just a short drive away.</p>
<p>The rough scenery and unspoiled nature around Lagos and the Costa Vicentina natural park are breathtaking. Our region has one of the biggest and best preserved coastlines in Europe. Some of the most beautiful places are only accessible by water – which makes it extremely exciting to explore this region on top of a SUP board or under a kite. Sandy beaches, crystalline lagoons, flat waters and fun waves – Southwest Algarve has it all.</p>
